english.title: Without authority move a flag / other mark distinguishing land for the purpose of the manoeuvres
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without due authority during a manoeuvres period, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..), moved a flag or other mark distinguishing for the purpose of the manoeuvres lands within a manoeuvres area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(2)(a) of the Manoeuvres Act 1958.
